# Ticket triage

Use this Skill when a new customer ticket arrives and has not been routed yet.

1. Read the ticket subject from the ticket record.
2. Set the queue to the one this desk handles.
3. Set the priority to the desk default.
4. Record the routing decision on the ticket.

## Escalation

Escalate to a human agent when the ticket names an account the desk does not
hold.
